description: This file defines FastAPI endpoints for managing container resources, including create, list, retrieve, and delete operations, following the OpenAI Containers API spec. It uses dependency injection, request processing, and external utility functions.

classes.name: ProxyBaseLLMRequestProcessing
classes.description: Handles processing of LLM requests, including base_process_llm_request and exception handling.

methods.name: create_container
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new container, processes request body, determines provider, and delegates to request processor.

methods.name: list_containers
methods.description: Endpoint to list containers, processes query parameters, determines provider, and delegates to request processor.

methods.name: retrieve_container
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve container details, processes container ID, determines provider, and delegates to request processor.

methods.name: delete_container
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a container, processes container ID, determines provider, and delegates to request processor.
